unit.zh: 遣子恪等率騎二千，晨出擊之。
unit.en: He sent his son Ke and others with two thousand horse in a dawn sally.
unit.literal: Sent sons Ke and others leading cavalry two thousand, dawn sortie struck them.

unit.zh: 季龍遣其將麻秋率眾迎遼，恪伏精騎七千於密雲山，大敗之，獲其司馬陽裕、將軍鮮于亮，擁段遼及其部眾以歸。
unit.en: Shi Hu sent his general Ma Qiu with troops to meet Duan Liao. Murong Ke stationed seven thousand elite cavalry in ambush at Miyun Mountain and routed them, captured marshal Yang Yu and general Xianyu Liang, and brought Duan Liao and his followers back.
unit.literal: Jilong sent his general Ma Qiu leading a host to meet Liao; Ke stationed seven thousand picked cavalry in ambush at Miyun Mountain and greatly defeated them, captured their marshal Yang Yu and general Xianyu Liang, and brought Duan Liao and his followers back.

unit.zh: 皝雖稱燕王，未有朝命，乃遣其長史劉祥獻捷京師，兼言權假之意，並請大舉討平中原。
unit.en: Though he called himself King of Yan, he still lacked a court mandate, so he sent his chief clerk Liu Xiang to report his victory at the capital, explain his provisional assumption of authority, and ask for a major campaign to pacify the Central Plain.
unit.literal: Although Huang styled himself King of Yan, there was yet no court mandate; he thereupon sent his chief clerk Liu Xiang to report his victory at the capital, also explaining his provisional assumption of authority and requesting a great campaign to pacify the Central Plain.

unit.zh: 冰見表及書甚懼，以其絕遠，非所能制，遂與何充等奏聽皝稱燕王。
unit.en: On seeing the memorial and the letter, Yu Bing was greatly alarmed; because Huang was so far away and beyond his power to control, he joined He Chong and others in memorializing that Huang be allowed to style himself King of Yan.
unit.literal: Bing seeing the memorial and letter was greatly afraid; because they were extremely distant, not what they could control; thereupon with He Chong and others memorialized to permit Huang to style King of Yan.

unit.zh: 皝乃令曰：「覽封記室之諫，孤實懼焉。
unit.en: Huang then issued an order, saying: “On reading the remonstrance of Recorder Feng, I am truly afraid.
unit.literal: Huang thereupon ordered, saying: “Having read Secretary Feng’s remonstrance, I truly fear it.

unit.zh: 皝大悅，還宮，赦其境內，號新宮曰和龍，立龍翔佛寺於山上。
unit.en: Huang was greatly pleased, returned to the palace, pardoned those within his borders, named the new palace Helong, and built the Longxiang Buddhist monastery on the mountain.
unit.literal: Huang was greatly pleased, returned to the palace, pardoned those within his borders, named the new palace Helong, and established the Longxiang Buddhist temple on the mountain.

unit.zh: 親造《太上章》以代《急就》，又著《典誡》十五篇，以教胄子。
unit.en: He personally composed the Taishang Chapter to replace the Jijiu, and also wrote fifteen chapters of Canonical Admonitions to teach the sons of the nobility.
unit.literal: He personally composed the Taishang Chapter to replace the Jijiu, and also wrote fifteen chapters of Canonical Admonitions, to teach the sons of the nobility.

unit.zh: 慕容恪攻高句麗南蘇，克之，置戍而還。
unit.en: Murong Ke attacked Goguryeo’s Nansu, took it, posted a garrison, and returned.
unit.literal: Murong Ke attacked Goguryeo’s Nansu, took it, set garrison and returned.

unit.zh: 但逆胡跨據神州，中原未靖，翰常克心自誓，志吞醜虜，上成先王遺旨，下謝山海之責。
unit.en: But the rebel Hu barbarians straddle and hold the Divine Land, and the Central Plain is not yet pacified. I always steeled my heart and swore that I would swallow up the vile caitiffs, above to fulfil the late king's dying wish and below to discharge my duty to the realm between the mountains and the sea.
unit.literal: But the rebellious Hu occupy the Divine Land, and the Central Plain is not yet pacified; Han has always steeled his heart and sworn an oath, intent on swallowing up the vile enemies, above to fulfil the late king's last instructions and below to discharge his duty to the land of mountains and seas.
